entries.title: Telling your first mate to merge puts a batched change in line
entries.body: On a project that merges your approved changes in batches, replying "merge" to your first mate under a change's merge card now approves that version and puts it in line for the next batch. Before, the first mate was refused and a second merge card went up for you to click.
entries.noPicture: This changes what happens after your reply, not how any view looks.
